description_zh: Waymo AV 在 Division Street 正常向西行驶，一辆特斯拉 Model 3 从后方追尾，后车曾闯停车标志，选择 ego 为被追尾的前车，NPC 为实施追尾的后车，用 rear_hit 表达典型追尾交互。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was traveling west on Division Street after having stopped at the stop sign at Vermont Street... a passenger car approached from behind the Waymo AV, ran the stop sign at Vermont Street, and made contact with the rear of the Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: 碰撞为后方车辆追尾前方正在行驶的 AV，符合 rear_hit 原语，位置为 behind_same_lane，无逆向或转弯，控制为无信号路段。
